fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole sailboat with trailer, which is a vessel we can detail.
findings: The first image is a reference drawing, not a photo of the actual boat
The real boat is almost entirely covered by a blue tarp, so the deck, cockpit and most of the hull cannot be seen
The small strip of hull visible below the tarp on the starboard side looks off-white, but it is too distant to judge gloss or oxidation
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1963 Cape Cod Bullseye. Since the boat has been covered and in storage a long time, the hull might benefit from a gelcoat polish so buyers see it at its best once the tarp comes off. We do pre-sale details and gelcoat polishing and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
